title: EC60101: Satellite Communications Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC31001 and EC31002 Evolution and growth of communication
satellites, Keplers laws of motion, orbits, altitude control; Satellite launch
vehicles; Arianne, SLV space shuttle; Sub systems of communication satellite;
Spectrum allocation and Bandwidth considerations; Propagation characteristics,
Satellite transponders and other sub systems; Earth station technology; Analog
and Digital link design; Multiple access techniques: FDMA, TDMA, SS-TDMA;
Interference in FDMA systems.
